title: Sindh Public Property Removal of Encroachment Amendment Ordinance 2010

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Property Removal of Encroachment Amendment Ordinance 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IX OF 2010
ORDINANCE IX OF 2010
SINDH PUBLIC PROPERTY (REMOVAL OF
ENCROACHMENT) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2010
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh
Public Property
(Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I,
3rd December, 2010]
No.S.Legis-1(9)/2001, dated 3-12-2010.---The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Public Property
(Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in season and the Governor is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action.
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance.
1. Short title and commencement.---This Ordinance may be called the Sindh
Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2010.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

shall be added:--
"(oo)"Special Court"
means a Special Court

(ii)

substituted:--
"26. A Special Court shall consist
